candidate.installation: Unpacked the exact npm tarballs in the guest. Recomputed archive and both npm package SHA-256 values there.

environment.hypervisor: Apple Virtualization.framework through Lima 2.2.1 (vz, plain mode)
environment.filesystems: Separate owner-only directories on the same guest ext4 filesystem and virtual block device. Root mount reported rw,relatime,discard,errors=remount-ro,commit=30.

method: Start a dedicated VM with a new instance home, a private writable virtual disk and no host mounts. Create a fresh witnessed ledger and one synthetic task per case. Sync fixture preparation before arming the fault.

For each case reopen the witnessed executor in resume mode and authenticate the token. A Linux ptrace parent waits for the barrier immediately before revokeTask. For the two native checkpoints, it stops the thread at syscall entry and identifies the journal or super-journal through the actual file descriptor or unlinkat path. The final case stops after revokeTask returns.

After receiving the checkpoint on the host, verify the target process owns the dedicated Lima instance and that its hostagent and VZ PID match. Send SIGKILL to that process without guest shutdown. Confirm the SSH session terminates and the rebooted guest reports a different kernel boot ID.

Reopen the original ledger and witness with their original key in resume mode. Test the same credential and an actual scoped read. After verification, independently compare the SHA-256 of the retained encrypted payload with the witness commitment.
interpretation: The two revocations interrupted before the native commit decision rolled back. The revocation already returned to its caller survived and the protected handler was never called. Each case resumed with a valid witness.
scope: Three selected power cuts on this guest and filesystem. Host power and physical disk caches stayed on. Separate virtual or physical disks, Windows/WSL2, disk firmware failure, loss of the host, backup custody and coordinated ledger-plus-witness rollback require separate evidence.
cleanup: Removed the disposable guest, its private disk, temporary SSH material and preparation files. The shared Colima VM remained separate.
